projects.architectureSummary: Apollo Core is a linearizable quorum-based replicated log engine written in Rust with C-bindings for node telemetry.

milestones.title: Phase 2: Chaos Mesh Partition & Split-Brain Validation

decisions.title: Adopt Speculative Read Barriers to Minimize Leader RTT
decisions.context: Under high geographical latency, linearizable reads required full round-trip consensus to the leader, creating an artificial p99 spike.
decisions.decision: Implemented monotonic read-lease epochs verified locally on follower nodes using synchronized monotonic clock drifts bounded by Chrony NTP.
decisions.consequences: Read throughput increased by 310%. Follower leases expire in 80ms if heartbeat is missed.

decisions.title: Migrate WAL Disk Flush from POSIX sync to io_uring Async Ring
decisions.context: Fsync syscall locks on high NVMe contention were stalling log replication threads during bursts.
decisions.decision: Replaced synchronous thread pool with dedicated submission and completion rings in Linux io_uring kernel subsystem.
decisions.consequences: Eliminated thread context switches. Maximum throughput increased to 125k ops/sec.
